---
title: "SOIL CRC Benefit–Cost Analysis Tool"
description: "Benefit–cost appraisal for farm-trial and soil-management interventions, with the assumptions exposed."
---

Assessing whether a farm trial or soil-management intervention is worth its cost
means committing to a discount rate, a time horizon and an adoption path. Reported
as a single ratio, those commitments disappear from view, and much of the ratio
comes from them rather than from the intervention.

This tool exposes them. Set the assumptions and sensitivity ranges yourself, and
it returns net present value, benefit–cost ratio, return on investment and a
sensitivity analysis. The useful output is often not the central estimate but the
range of assumptions under which the conclusion flips.

For researchers and partners evaluating agricultural production trials.
